notes.title: The Majestic Devlog #12 | I Finished a Huge Water Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5pMGP8TMyUo;full][/previewyoutube]

In this devlog I show the huge water update for my game, adding fish, plant life, and a custom swimming mode using ChatGPT for help with some of the programming. 

I hope you enjoy and please let me know what you think in the comments. 
Please subscribe for more updates and also please consider wishlisting the game on Steam!
